from __future__ import annotations
import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.schema import (
    normalize_schema,
    validate_schema_output,
)

pytestmark = [
    pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]"),
    pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit"),
]

class Answer(BaseModel):
    answer: int

@pytest.mark.coverage_item("VC_SCHEMA_PYDANTIC_RECONSTRUCTION")
def test_pydantic_schema_preserves_contract_and_reconstructs_requested_model() -> None:
    spec = normalize_schema(Answer)
    result = validate_schema_output(spec, '{"answer": 3}')

    assert spec.model_type is Answer
    assert dict(spec.json_schema) == Answer.model_json_schema()
    assert result.valid is True
    assert result.value == Answer(answer=3)

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import normalize_schema, validate_schema_output

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_STRUCTURED_SCHEMA_CONTRACT[revision==2]")
def test_mapping_schema_is_isolated_from_caller_nested_mutation() -> None:
    schema = {
        "title": "Payload",
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "a": {"type": "integer"},
            "inner": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"count": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1}},
                "required": ["count"],
            },
        },
        "required": ["a"],
    }
    spec = normalize_schema(schema)

    schema["properties"]["a"]["type"] = "string"
    schema["properties"]["inner"]["properties"]["count"]["minimum"] = 100

    assert spec.json_schema["properties"]["a"]["type"] == "integer"
    inner = spec.json_schema["properties"]["inner"]
    assert inner["properties"]["count"]["minimum"] == 1

    good = validate_schema_output(spec, '{"a": 1, "inner": {"count": 2}}')
    bad_type = validate_schema_output(spec, '{"a": "x"}')
    bad_nested = validate_schema_output(spec, '{"a": 1, "inner": {"count": 0}}')

    assert good.valid is True
    assert good.value == {"a": 1, "inner": {"count": 2}}
    assert bad_type.valid is False
    assert bad_nested.valid is False
